familyQuestionPolicy.question: How do I do a walk test on an MxPro panel?
familyQuestionPolicy.basis: Both reviewed guides describe the same TEST → ZONES sequence, sounder choice, zone selection, activation, automatic reset and FINISHED TEST exit. Their Level 2 main menus differ elsewhere; these differences do not change the walk-test route.
familyQuestionPolicy.answerPolicy: Allow family-worded questions, but clearly scope the answer to the proposed and downloaded manual. Download approval is not confirmation of the installed panel model. A question explicitly naming MxPro4 or MxPro5 must use that model family’s evidence.
familyQuestionPolicy.unknownVersions: No claim is made that later revisions, firmware changes, other panel families or installation-specific output programming behave identically.

sourceLimits: These user guides describe programmed sounder operation in walk test. They do not establish that all other outputs or remote signalling are suppressed; the answer must not claim this.
Esc alone does not establish restoration: FINISHED TEST cancels all zone tests; KEEP ZONES IN TEST leaves them active.
No default access code is supplied or inferred.

Manufacturer-authored documents are hosted by the existing catalogue’s third-party source. Their file hashes identify the reviewed copies; no manufacturer endorsement or current-revision guarantee is implied.
